content.text: The E2g and A1g fits are sensible, but the pseudo-Voigt mixing parameter is degenerate and the A1g peak comes out much broader than E2g. I'll refit with fixed Lorentzian and Gaussian shapes to check that, and fit the Si line to calibrate the wavenumber axis.

cd "C:/WINDOWS/TEMP/ramanlens-eval/v3-id-devhard-haiku/bare/syn-MoS2-04" && python -I -c "
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from lmfit.models import PseudoVoigtModel, LorentzianModel, GaussianModel, LinearModel
d=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv')
x=d.shift_cm1.values; y=d.intensity.values
def run(lo,hi,peaks,label,bgmodel=LinearModel):
    m=(x>lo)&(x<hi); xs,ys=x[m],y[m]
    mod=bgmodel(prefix='bg_')
    p=mod.make_params(); p['bg_slope'].set(value=0); p['bg_intercept'].set(value=np.median(ys))
    for pre,cls,c0,a0,s0 in peaks:
        mm=cls(prefix=pre); mod=mod+mm
        p.update(mm.make_params())
        p[pre+'center'].set(value=c0,min=c0-4,max=c0+4); p[pre+'amplitude'].set(value=a0,min=0); p[pre+'sigma'].set(value=s0,min=0.2,max=10)
    r=mod.fit(ys,p,x=xs)
    chi=np.sqrt(np.mean(r.residual**2))
    print('==',label,'rms',round(chi,1),'BIC',round(r.bic,1))
    for pre,cls,c0,a0,s0 in peaks:
        print('  ',pre,'center %.2f FWHM %.2f area %.0f'%(r.params[pre+'center'].value, 2*r.params[pre+'sigma'].value, r.params[pre+'amplitude'].value*(np.pi*r.params[pre+'sigma'].value if cls is LorentzianModel else np.sqrt(2*np.pi)*r.params[pre+'sigma'].value)) )
    return r
for cls in [LorentzianModel,GaussianModel]:
    run(340,460,[('e_',cls,382.8,3e4,1.5),('a_',cls,406,2e4,2)],'MoS2 '+cls.__name__)
run(340,460,[('e_',PseudoVoigtModel,382.8,3e4,1.5),('a_',PseudoVoigtModel,406,2e4,2)],'MoS2 pV')
run(495,545,[('s_',LorentzianModel,520.6,2e4,1.5)],'Si Lorentz')
run(495,545,[('s_',GaussianModel,520.6,2e4,1.5)],'Si Gauss')
run(495,545,[('s_',PseudoVoigtModel,520.6,2e4,1.5)],'Si pV')
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.signal import find_peaks, savgol_filter
from lmfit.models import PseudoVoigtModel, LinearModel, LorentzianModel
d=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv')
x=d.shift_cm1.values; y=d.intensity.values
# smoothed peak search, low threshold
ys=savgol_filter(y,9,2)
bg=np.polyval(np.polyfit(x,ys,1),x)
r=ys-bg
noise=1.4826*np.median(np.abs(np.diff(y)))/np.sqrt(2)
print('noise est (diff-based)', round(noise,1))
p,pr=find_peaks(r, prominence=3*noise, width=2)
for i,pp in enumerate(p): print('cand', round(x[pp],2), round(y[pp],0), 'prom', round(pr['prominences'][i],0))
# residual after removing 3 peaks in full range
m=np.ones_like(x,bool)
